prompt:

Paint the same man clearly aged to 45, a middle-aged father of a 17-year-old: same face as Cheng Che in the reference: same eyes, same face shape, short slightly messy black hair cut shorter and neater with obvious gray at the temples and some gray strands on top, visible lines at the corners of the eyes and on the forehead, a slightly fuller jaw and face, a little less youthful skin; he must look obviously older than image 1, a man in his mid forties, still lean from running. He wears a dark green polo shirt and khaki trousers. Expression: quiet, gentle.
Framing: character portrait for a visual novel, from the top of the head down to mid-thigh, body turned slightly (three-quarter front view), face toward the viewer, arms relaxed at the sides. Expression: calm, gentle, mouth closed.
Painting style: match the style anchor image only for technique: soft transparent watercolor, gentle paper-grain texture inside the figure, pale luminous palette, loose wet edges inside the painting but a clean readable outline against the background. Background: one single flat uniform pure chroma green color (#00FF00) filling the entire background, perfectly even, no gradient, no texture, no shadow, no floor, no vignette. The figure must not touch any edge of the image; leave green margin above the head and at both sides. Correct anatomy, five fingers on each hand. Single figure, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Portrait orientation.
